description.en:
Closes a movie: hides the OBJ_MOVIE layout object and deletes the movie object.
A movie object is named by the movie name: CMND_MOVIE_OPEN loads data movie/<name>.moflex into an object of that name, and the other CMND_MOVIE_* commands find it by the same name. None of these commands is used by the shipped scripts; the story plays its movies with the ev_main helper PlayMovie, which uses CMND_MAKE_CHILD_MOVIE_SCENE.
Movie name, without folder or extension (the file is movie/<name>.moflex).

true if the movie was found and closed, false otherwise.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Open, play and close a movie (not found in script_clean/; invented, the movie name is made up)
